full_judgment: 2. Appellant instituted the suit for recovery of Taka 1,32,52,808.73. The trial Court by the judgment and order dated 13.04.1997 decreed the suit in part directing the defendant to pay Tk.55,18,244/- within 3(three) months from date of the decree failing which he will pay interest at the rate of Tk.18% from date of default. Uttara Bank Limited thereafter preferred this appeal against the said judgment before the High Court Division. The High Court Division allowed the appeal in part and the High Court Division maintained the decree of Tk. 55,18,244/- but reduced the interest pendentelite.
